title: Tiramisù
author: Lorenzo
description: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa.
steps: Whisk the yolks with the sugar until pale, then fold in the mascarpone.
Whip the whites to stiff peaks and fold them gently into the mascarpone cream.
Dip the ladyfingers quickly in the coffee and lay them in a dish; cover with cream. Repeat.
Chill for at least 4 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.
